## Deferrals read

- `D-P27.4-1` (national export), `D-R6.5-SURFACE` (materialized-surface republish), `D-P27.8-1` (hosted
  cut-over) — this ticket's closures → **DONE** with evidence.
- `D-P30.3-COUNSEL` — stays OPEN (no written opinion on file).
- `D-R6.1-EVAL` — stays OPEN; the PROVISIONAL disclosure is published with the headline.
- `D-P27.5-1` — the presentation analytics; extended by `D-P30.3-3` (the demo constants are no longer rendered).
- `D-P21.7-1` — contribution-back not activated → the public leverage metric is the honest 0 of 0.
- `D-P30.2-2` — edges/accountability empty → the network surface shows its honest empty state.

## Requirements (contract + operator deliverables)

1. New ADR superseding ADR-096's classifier (share-alike public as separate compartments; UNDETERMINED/
   excluded restricted; mixed-licence refused) + `publish.py` + tests; BL-056, Appendix F, BUILD.sh, index.
2. National export `--from-spine` over the materialized hosted spine, one read-only snapshot; measure; run in
   GCP if slow; record the watermark.
3. Publish the resolved-site headline exactly as the export computes it, with the PROVISIONAL disclosure.
4. Public cut-over: export-mode `web/dist` (fail loud, no fixtures) → partition → assert-clean → sync public
   buckets; restricted private; verify the real serving path (LB → NEG → Cloud Run `sig-web`).
5. Hosted verification on both URLs (probe-hosted, national data not the demo, headline, ODbL attribution,
   zero-JS content pages, valid TLS, watermark).
6. PUBLICATION_CHECKLIST launch section; close the three deferrals.

## Acceptance criteria

- AC1 export built from the materialized hosted spine, compartmented, gates green, real materialized numbers.
- AC2 cut-over prepared + proven clean, synced, restricted private, probe green, national data live on both URLs,
  watermark recorded.
- AC3 `make check` + build-memory green; deferrals flipped with evidence; no fabricated URL/watermark.

## Plan

Measure the hosted spine first (read-only, `cloud-sql-proxy --token`), attempt the export locally, fall back to
an in-GCP Cloud Run job if the laptop cannot hold it; build the classifier change + tests; build the site against
the real bundle and fix every blocker the real data surfaces; prove the partition clean; sync; verify live.

## Progress

- Spine measured: claims 2,304,784 (= P30.2b), camera-site run `camsite:13bedfe7…`, `sig-pg` `db-custom-2-8192`
  (untouched).
- Local export over the proxy: data fetch ~90 s but the laptop is memory-starved (swap full) → the second
  attempt stalled; moved to GCP: `ops/gcp/export.sh` (Cloud Run job `sig-export`, 4 CPU / 16 GiB, restricted
  bucket via gcsfuse, tagged image, never `:latest`).
- First hosted build (local attempt) STOPPED by the fail-closed licence gate: `dot_511_ky` carries CC0 and
  decision-resolved public-record rows; the per-source rights index merged them. Fixed: per-(source, rights)
  slicing for multi-rights sources.
- Found `web/map.json` labelled CC-BY-4.0 while carrying every compartment's points (ODbL included) — relabelled
  with the SPDX `AND` of its licences → restricted build input; tiles filed under their own compartment.
- Export 1 (`sig-export-h8xjp`, image `export-71e91a7bcb20`, 14:59:33→15:14:38Z) → web build against it failed
  loud, in order: missing `leverage.json` (→ `osm-feed pull --no-feed`, never the fixture changesets); all 178
  freshness rows blank (hosted ingest_run rows never closed → explicit `not-recorded`, D-P30.3-1); dossier
  action blocks `{}` (→ full shape, explicitly unknown — `{}` rendered auto-renewal as "no"); map absence kinds
  outside the web vocabulary; the single merged `sig-infrastructure.pmtiles` the build expected (→ per-compartment
  archives, per-compartment style sources).
- Honesty audit of the built national site: OKC demo constants rendered as data (density bins, centrality, the
  "OKCPD ALPR renewal" decision point, worked-OKC provenance on every page, Paris/Brussels demo dossiers, demo
  jurisdiction claims) → export builds read only optional `web/presentation/*.json` (fixture harness ships them);
  site provenance derived from the export; `/curate/` stripped from the public dist; web sync mirrors the build.
- Map island: 225,105 points as props would be tens of MB of HTML → static `/map/points.json` (17 MB) fetched on
  hydration.
- Export 2 (final, image `export-950d4ebc672b`): `sig-export-tl4mx` 15:41:10→15:51:41Z → fetched (39 s).
- Prepare → partition 128 public / 1 restricted → clean → syncs (restricted 15:54Z, public 15:54→16:13Z, web
  16:13Z). Live check found the island hydrating with NOTHING drawn: the maplibre v6 worker 404'd
  (pre-existing since P27.9 — never emitted by the bundle) → bundled via `?worker&url` + `setWorkerUrl`,
  `data-drawn` e2e assertion; web re-synced 16:20Z; 225,105 points now drawn on both origins.
- Independent fresh-context review (Phase 3 Pass 2 + gap walk): no blocker. Fixed: S1 the site was never checked
  against the partition → `assert_site_matches_partition` (a withheld compartment's tiles cannot be served; the
  ADR-106 data-row rollback now takes it off the site too); S2 an unregistered compartment fell through to public
  (an all-OSM `web/map.json` labelled ODbL would have become a second public `web` licence and failed the publish)
  → `unregistered-compartment` + the export's own `web`/`metadata` declared CC-BY-4.0; S3 `/map/points.json` is
  the site's rendering data drawing on every compartment → recorded explicitly in ADR-106 §5 as produced-work
  data and flagged to counsel (D-P30.3-COUNSEL note); S4 publishing refuses an export carrying the fixture
  harness's `web/presentation/`; S5 `--no-feed` / `--fixtures` mutually exclusive; nits: a listed artifact
  missing on disk fails loud, the absence-kind test pins `UNRESOLVED`, the island aborts its fetch on unmount and
  handles the rejection, the tile copy uses the manifest list the style uses. Not taken: S6 (network surface
  label/refused filter — pre-existing, network empty today; it is ADR-106's revisit trigger); attribution text
  from `compartments.*.source` and `source_independence_count` semantics (noted, D-P30.3-3).
  Web re-synced 16:48Z after the fixes; public partition byte-identical (dry-run: only mtime-flagged
  `LICENCES.json`/`manifest.json`, `cmp` identical).
